title: rubus koehleri subsp. reuteri
intro: Rubus koehleri subsp. reuteri, commonly known as Korean raspberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus koehleri plant, belonging to the rose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus koehleri subsp. reuteri include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and other phenolic compounds. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to have immunomodulatory and vasodilatory effects, further supporting its use in traditional medicine.
